bio.text: According to his campaign website, Shawn Harris was the 2024 nominee in Georgia's 14th Congressional District and is campaigning there again in 2026.
According to his campaign website, he is a retired Army brigadier general and Polk County cattle producer who returned to Georgia after 40 years of military service.
The campaign says he grew up in Blakely, Georgia, enlisted in the U.S. Marine Corps after high school, and later earned a B.A. in agribusiness from Tuskegee University.
